title: Inter's greatest season ever? 1964–65 vs the 2010 treble — we picked
caption: Inter's greatest season of all time? 1964–65: Herrera's Grande Inter won the Scudetto, the European Cup and the Intercontinental Cup — champions of Italy, Europe and the world in one season. 2009–10: Mourinho's treble — Serie A, Coppa Italia and the Champions League, the only one by an Italian club. 2023–24: 94 points and the second star. We picked. Who's yours? #Inter #ForzaInter #GrandeInter #Treble #SerieA https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/tt/?v=debate6
